---
name: "SCAP Seed: challenge a claim"
about: Argue that a claim is wrong, too strong, irrelevant, or rests on a hidden premise
title: "[scap-seed] Challenge: "
---

**Which claim?** (an ID from scap-seed/CLAIMS.md, a theorem name, or a quote)

**What do you think is wrong?** (wrong / too strong / irrelevant to the real system / hidden premise / other)

**Why?** Your argument, counterexample or evidence.

**What would settle it?** A proof, a counterexample, a simulation or data that would show who is right.
